defects: All four actors have their feet planted side-by-side in a static standing pose rather than a walking stride as they advance down the lane, and contact shadows on the floor are missing.
tiles.fix: Add alternating foot strides for the walk cycle (small steps for Zoubida and Fatma) and ground contact shadows.

defects: Fatma is staged directly behind the father at x≈480 so half of her body and face are occluded by his left shoulder.
All four characters still have side-by-side standing feet instead of walking strides.
tiles.fix: Offset Fatma to screen left into the gap between the father and Zoubida so all four actors read clearly, and pose their legs in mid-stride.

defects: Mohammed's eye level is below the top edge of the counter, so he stares straight into the solid wooden front panel instead of seeing the jewels displayed on top.
His pose does not match the brief: his eyes are wide open and head level instead of chin tucked with lids half down in an unimpressed slow head shake.
tiles.fix: Lower the counter or stage Mohammed so he can see the display top, tuck his chin, lower his eyelids halfway, and angle his head in a slight dismissive turn.

The background plate has a hard vertical seam down the center (x≈520) joining indoor souk stalls on the left with a sunlit outdoor street with green trees on the right.
tiles.fix: Lower the man's two cupped hands to chest height holding a visible family jewel, bow both heads over it, and replace the split background with a consistent indoor souk plate.

defects: The man's and woman's hands and faces clip directly into each other at nose/mouth level with the woman's white headscarf intersecting the man's face, and no family jewel is visible.
The mismatched indoor/outdoor split background seam remains visible behind the woman at x≈520.
tiles.fix: Separate the two heads so they bow over the jewel in the man's cupped hands without facial clipping, and fix the split background plate.

defects: The dellal's head is level in profile with his mouth closed and occluded by his own raised upper arm instead of having his head thrown back and mouth wide open shouting.
The dellal's raised right hand holds oversized thick brown wooden-looking rings clipping into the ceiling lanterns rather than a pair of gold bracelets dangling from his hand.

Zoubida still stands with her back turned to the camera as a wide white cone occluding Fatma.

defects: The father stares horizontally at the dellal's face instead of looking down at the bracelets in his hand.

tiles.fix: Repair the haik cloth skinning and arm rig on both Zoubida and Fatma so they cleanly try the bracelets on their wrists, and reframe the medium crop slightly higher to avoid cutting the father's turban.
